crossRefs.note: “Speak, you who ride on white donkeys, you who sit on rich carpets, and you who walk by the way.
He had thirty sons who rode on thirty donkey colts. They had thirty cities, which are called Havvoth Jair to this day…

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: He had forty sons and thirty sons’ sons who rode on seventy donkey colts. He judged Israel eight years.
translations.bsb: He had forty sons and thirty grandsons, who rode on seventy donkeys. And he judged Israel eight years.
translations.kjv: And he had forty sons and thirty nephews, that rode on threescore and ten ass colts: and he judged Israel eight years.
translations.asv: And he had forty sons and thirty sons' sons, that rode on threescore and ten ass colts: and he judged Israel eight years.
